requirements.statement: Preserve workflow format, output lineage, permissions and existing run visibility
Commit durable state before acknowledging or dispatching dependent work; reject unsafe storage modes
Stable operation identity, canonical inputs, strict divergence detection and reusable completed results
Persist model turns/tool batches and resume from a recorded continuation
Classify and reconcile external effects; bound retry amplification and cost
Persist approval waits and consume exact authorized decisions once across restart
Persist child creation, results, joins and inherited constraints
Enforce ownership epochs and terminal/cancellation fences
Atomically admit schedule occurrences and apply explicit overdue policy
Pin compatibility and support reversible, nonduplicating migration
Keep credentials out of the journal and scope every command to the workspace/principal
Show clear recovery states and safe actions in existing Work/Run views
Conserve budgets, attempts and deadlines across retry, delegation, sleep and restart
Provide reconciliation telemetry, backup, retention and a recovery runbook
Release only after independent fault testing and staged compatibility verification
Cross-machine automatic recovery and distributed leases
